remarks: Beautifully updated home that's truly move-in ready. This freshly painted property features new fixtures throughout, updated bathrooms, and stylish new countertops paired with brand-ew appliances for modern, effortless living. Major improvements include new electrical, and mechanical systems, a new roof, new siding, new windows, and a brand new garage door/wiring, offering peace of mind for years to come. The home blends classic charm with thoughtful upgrades, providing comfortable living spaces filled with natural light and clean contemporary finishes throughout. Ideally located just minutes from downtown Norwalk, you'll enjoy easy access to restaurants, shopping, cafes, parks and entertainment, Commuters will appreciate nearby Metro_north train stations, while Calf Pasture Beach, Veterans Park, and local marinas provide abundant outdoor and waterfront activities. With convenient access to major highways, this home delivers the perfect balance of comfort, location, and lifestyle.
